description: Renovate is the single owner of dependency updates for this repo; keep repository-level (UI) Dependabot disabled.
Covers: npm dependencies (package.json + package-lock.json), GitHub Actions pins, and the digest-pinned Node base image in the Dockerfile.
@types/node describes the runtime, so its major must track the Node base image rather than its own latest.
Left alone Renovate raises it to the newest major, which type-allows APIs the running Node does not have — a failure that typechecks clean and appears at runtime.
Raise this ceiling in the same change that moves the Dockerfile to a newer Node.
bedrock-protocol tracks the Minecraft wire protocol, and this image bakes in the protocol data for exactly one Bedrock version.
An upgrade can therefore change which server versions the bot can reach at all, so it is reviewed on its own rather than inside the weekly batch.
